rows.note: Use 送 as the all-purpose choice for taking or delivering a person or physical thing somewhere.

example.english: I’ll send the document to you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sung3 fan6 man4 gin6 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use 寄 when sending a letter, parcel, or other item through the post or a delivery service.

example.english: I’ll send you a letter tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 gei3 fung1 seon3 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use 發 when sending a message, text, email, or other electronic communication.

example.english: I’ll send you a message now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 faat3 go3 seon3 sik1 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this construction for dispatching someone to do something, including sending an agent to fetch or summon a person or thing.

example.english: I’ll send someone to pick you up.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 paai3 jan4 heoi3 zip3 nei5
